I can't give you an amount for caffeine. That's one for a doctor or dietitian, since what's reasonable depends on your body, your medications and how you sleep.

In general terms, coffee before training is common and tolerance varies a lot from person to person. Most people do better having it a while before they train rather than right on the way in. Take note of how it affects your sleep, your heart rate and your stomach, and keep it from creeping into the afternoon if it costs you sleep.

If you want a number that's right for you, ask your doctor or a dietitian. Meanwhile, what are we training today?
